content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

For muscle building, aim for 0.7–1.0 g of protein per lb of body weight daily (roughly 1.6–2.2 g per kg). This supports muscle protein synthesis when combined with progressive resistance training and adequate calories overall.

That said, the most important factors are consistency with your training, eating enough total calories, and getting enough sleep—protein alone won't build muscle without those. Spread your intake across meals for better absorption, and get it from quality sources: meat, fish, eggs, dairy, legumes, or quality supplements.
